_comment: Optional text templates for CloudShare. Copy to /opt/cloudshare/env/config/templates.json (chmod 644) and
update the stack. Without the file the built-in texts are used. Resolution per field: users (sender address /
UPN) → groups (the sender's department in Microsoft 365) → default → built-in. Problems are logged at start.
sms_template            {password} (required), {sender_name}, {files} (first file name in GSM characters, shortened,
and how many more – never the link) – GSM characters only, keep it under 160;
put {password} on a line of its own – phones may hyphenate a long word where they wrap the line
mail_password_intro     {subject}, {sender_name}, {count} – text above the card; empty line = new paragraph
{password} is only allowed in the SMS; the SMS never contains the link, only the shortened file name via {files}.
Texts per language: every level may hold "languages": { "en": { … } } – they win over the level's own texts for a
mail in that language (SMS and password mail: the language chosen for the recipients; download confirmation: the
language of the sender's add-in). Without them the level's own texts apply in every language.
